title: lncRNA-aware single-cell re-analysis of the human Liver Cell Atlas: code and result tables
description: Analysis code, intermediate result tables, and donor-level validation for the manuscript "MEG3 is a donor-reproducible endothelial lncRNA in the human liver single-cell atlas" (Hidenori Tani). Primary data are public via GEO accession GSE192742 and are not redistributed here.
